title: Choice
description: A choice made from the catalogs (spec section 5): the question, what the need is, what was searched and tried, the pick and why. Read from docs/choices/*.yaml; its candidates are candidate items.

need.description: what the pick must do: each candidate is tried against these

searched.description: the source catalogs searched, and how

trial.description: how the shortlist was tested: script, queries, when, what was expected

verdict.description: the Morphogen verdict that decided it, or why none was needed
